reviewNotes: Reference: Meta SAM 2 official architecture image, assets/model_diagram.png at commit 2b90b9f5ceec907a1c18123530e92e794ad901a4.
Reconstructed from the public PNG only; model implementation and diagram source were not used to recover geometry.
Text, encoder/attention/decoder/memory modules, temporal-feedback paths, and arrows are native independently editable objects.
Eight photographic frame crops retain source pixels, including segmentation overlays and fading. No diagram label or network module is flattened into a crop.
English labels use Times New Roman, matching the serif appearance of the reference. Polygons approximate small rounded trapezoid corners.
Past-frame transparency is represented by pale solid native fills. Arrows are independent editable paths, without automatic connector binding.
This is a diagram reconstruction, not an implementation or performance reproduction of SAM 2.
